name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: TEST SEARCH-ONLY BUILD (v0.6.4.3): drops certDB.getCerts() from the send path entirely (0.6.4.1 PROVED the full PK11_ListCerts enumeration breaks reading of incoming mail even with zero writes). Instead doCleanup(email) takes the signing identity's email from the compose window (win.gCurrentIdentity.email -- confirmed the real global in 0.6.4.2; 'emailSigningIdentity' does NOT exist), does ONE targeted certDB.findCertByEmailAddress() lookup, then removes the matching stale cert9.db row by DER via a direct SQL DELETE (no constructX509(), no deleteCertificate(), no PKCS#11 sweep). Shutdown trigger passes no email and is effectively disabled in this build. Purpose: see whether a single targeted lookup + pure-SQL delete keeps reading working after a signed send.
